content.title: Lakeside Greeting Micro-Arc | Bouquet Anchor, Eye Response and Quiet Hold
content.summary: An adult artist with paper flowers moves from direct greeting to a calm lakeward profile. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity, wardrobe, bouquet and camera position remain fixed. + Only small facial, hand, breathing and head actions drive the performance. + Every gesture completes before the next one begins. + Environmental motion remains secondary and physically gentle. + The final profile preserves the same subject, prop and landscape composition.
quick_start.recommended_input: Frame one original adult ceramic artist in a pale blue dress holding a bouquet of paper flowers beside a silver lake. Raise the free hand once to touch one paper petal beside the cheek, then lower it to the bouquet. End on a calm three-quarter profile, bouquet centered and the original mountain-water line unchanged.

invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Only small facial, hand, breathing and head actions drive the performance."

invariants.rule: Every gesture completes before the next one begins.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every gesture completes before the next one begins."

invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Environmental motion remains secondary and physically gentle."

invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final profile preserves the same subject, prop and landscape composition."
